title: Purification of Plasmid DNA by Miniprep
author: Georgina Elisa Diego Macías

steps.title: Harvest Cell Pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 1-5 mL of the overnight LB-culture and remove all medium.

steps.title: Resuspend Cell Pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet until homogeneous using Resuspension Buffer (R3) containing RNase A.

substeps.instruction: Add 250 µL Resuspension Buffer (R3) with RNase A to the cell pellet

steps.title: Lyse Cells
steps.instruction: Lyse the cells and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Add 250 µL Lysis Buffer (L7)
Mix gently by inverting the capped tube until homogeneous (do not vortex)
Incubate the tube at room temperature for 00:05:00

steps.title: Precipitate DNA
steps.instruction: Precipitate the DNA and centrifuge to separate the lysate.

substeps.instruction: Add 350 µL Precipitation Buffer (N4)
Mix immediately by inverting the tube (or vigorously shaking for large pellets) until homogeneous; do not vortex
Centrifuge the lysate at >12,000 × g for 00:10:00

steps.title: Load Spin Column
steps.instruction: Load the supernatant onto a spin column and centrifuge.

substeps.instruction: Load the supernatant from the previous step onto a spin column in a 2-mL wash tube
Centrifuge the column at 12,000 × g for 00:01:00
Discard the flowthrough and place the column back into the wash tube

steps.title: First Wash
steps.instruction: Perform the first wash of the column using Wash Buffer (W10).

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL Wash Buffer (W10) with ethanol to the column
Incubate the column for 00:01:00 at room temperature
Centrifuge the column at 12,000 × g for 00:01:00
Discard the flowthrough and place column back into the wash tube

steps.title: Second Wash
steps.instruction: Perform the second wash of the column using Wash Buffer (W9).

substeps.instruction: Add 700 µL Wash Buffer (W9) with ethanol to the column
Centrifuge the column at 12,000 × g for 00:01:00
Discard the flowthrough and place the column into the wash tube
Centrifuge the column at 12,000 × g for 00:01:00
Discard the wash tube with the flowthrough

steps.title: Elute Plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: Elute the purified plasmid DNA using preheated TE Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Place the Spin Column in a clean 1.5-mL elution tube
Add 75 µL of preheated TE Buffer (TE) to the center of the column
Incubate the column for 00:01:00 at room temperature
Centrifuge the column at 12,000 × g for 2 minutes

steps.title: Store Purified DNA
steps.instruction: Discard the column and store the purified plasmid DNA.

substeps.instruction: Store plasmid DNA at 4°C for short term
Store DNA in aliquots at −20°C for long term
